t: 希洛的胡利切人反抗西班牙的殖民者.
te: Huilliches in Chiloé rebel against Spanish encomenderos.
dz: 希洛的胡利切人反抗西班牙的殖民者.
de: Huilliches in Chiloé rebel against Spanish encomenderos.

t: 2月29日之后是瑞典的2月30日,此举废除了瑞典历法来回儒略历.
te: February 29 is followed by February 30 in Sweden, in a move to abolish the Swedish calendar for a return to the Julian …
dz: 2月29日之后是瑞典的2月30日,此举废除了瑞典历法来回儒略历.
de: February 29 is followed by February 30 in Sweden, in a move to abolish the Swedish calendar for a return to the Julian calendar.

t: 1712年纽约奴隶革命从百老汇附近开始.
te: The New York Slave Revolt of 1712 begins near Broadway.
dz: 1712年纽约奴隶革命从百老汇附近开始.
de: The New York Slave Revolt of 1712 begins near Broadway.

t: 维拉斯元帅领导下的法国人于德奈恩战胜了萨沃伊的尤金,取得了决定性的胜利.
te: The French under Marshal Villars win a decisive victory over Eugene of Savoy at Denain.
dz: 西班牙继承之战:维拉斯元帅领导下的法国人于德奈恩战胜了萨沃伊的尤金,取得了决定性的胜利.
de: War of the Spanish Succession: The French under Marshal Villars win a decisive victory over Eugene of Savoy at Denain.

t: 蒙特罗斯公爵签发了逮捕罗布·罗伊·麦克格雷戈的逮捕令.
te: The Duke of Montrose issues a warrant for the arrest of Rob Roy MacGregor.
dz: 蒙特罗斯公爵签发了逮捕罗布·罗伊·麦克格雷戈的逮捕令.
de: The Duke of Montrose issues a warrant for the arrest of Rob Roy MacGregor.
